global_prompt: A continuous cinematic professional kitchen shot. The same middle-aged chef with gray stubble stands at the same stainless steel counter, reviewing the completed chocolate dessert. The environment, lighting, depth of field, and camera style remain consistent and realistic.
local_prompts: The chef continues straightening his posture, lifting his torso slightly away from the counter.
He keeps his gaze fixed on the dessert, calmly judging the final presentation.
The camera pulls back just a little, revealing more of the stainless steel counter and the softly blurred kitchen behind him.
He places both hands lightly near the edge of the counter, no longer touching the plate.
His expression softens into quiet approval as he observes the completed garnish.
The scene holds a balanced composition with the chef above the counter and the dessert centered below him.
